;(C)LYNX'99
;SOME LITTLE HELP DR.SYSTEM

               ORG     #7000
; ---------

duatr          EQU     #7000;ATTRIBUTES
border         EQU     #7001
winatr         EQU     #7002
butatr         EQU     #7004
nameatr        EQU     #7006
chbxatr        EQU     #7008
dwatr          EQU     #700a
koncol         EQU     #700c;KONSOL ATTR
track          EQU     #700e;EXTENDED DIRECTORY TRRACK
ext            EQU     #7010;DB      "SCRRLECMP123123123123"
free           EQU     #7025;UNUSED
fils           EQU     #7027;FILES ON DISK
lstf           EQU     #7029;LAST FILE NUMBER
delf           EQU     #702a;DELETED FILES
flg            EQU     #702c
cords          EQU     #702d
xtxt           EQU     #702e
ytxt           EQU     #702f
xlen           EQU     #7030
ylen           EQU     #7031
fn             EQU     #7032
pnosn          EQU     #7033
flgs           EQU     #7034
filwin         EQU     #7036
cur            EQU     #7037
step           EQU     #7039;MOUSE STEP
restbl         EQU     #703a;RESIDENTS TABLE
               ORG     #7058
obois          DB      "FlyShit C",0
music          DB      "MUS     C",0
theme          DB      "THEME   C",0
plugin         DB      "PLUG1   o",0
csr            DB      "CURSOR  C",0
resid          DB      "CLOCK   C",0
ssaver         DB      "SAVER   C",0
setnm          DB      "fsetup  s",0
plugv          EQU     #70a8;PLUG VIEW (CALL WH. UNKN. EXT)
data           EQU     #70aa;DATA FOR NUMBER PRINT
mpl            EQU     #70b2;MUSIC PLAY ADDRES
stime          EQU     #70b4;SCREEN SAVER TIME ELAPSED
               ORG     #7100
setwin         EQU     #7100;SET WINDOW
checkw         EQU     #7103;CHECK WINDOW
animal         EQU     #7106;MOUSE
dopus          EQU     #7109
read           EQU     #710c;REREAD DISK CATALOG TO #C000
multy          EQU     #710f;HL=B*C
page           EQU     #7112;SET PAGE
cpblok         EQU     #7115;CP TWO BLOCK (HL&DE)
gtadr          EQU     #7118;GET ADDR OF FILE DESC (IN PAGE 0)
getext         EQU     #711b;GET ADDR OF EXTENDED FILE DESC
clearbf        EQU     #711e;CLEAR FILENAME BUFFER
viewf          EQU     #7121;VIEW FILE (FNM=NUMBER OF FILENAME)
xyatr          EQU     #7124;XY->ADDR IN ATR
xyscr          EQU     #7127;XY->ADDR IN SCR
prstr          EQU     #712a;Print String HL-ADDR,BC -COOR.
remw           EQU     #712d;REMOVE WINDOW FROM SCREEN
shutay         EQU     #7130;SHUT UP MUSIC COPROC
paused         EQU     #7133;PAUSE
press          EQU     #7136;PRESS ZNK IN SCR(BC - COORDINATES)
putspr         EQU     #7139;PUT SPRITE
prsum          EQU     #713c;SET NUMBER (IN HL) TO DATA STRING)
uph            EQU     #713f;UP H
downh          EQU     #7142;DOWN H
mnu            EQU     #7145;MAIN MENU
dos            EQU     #7148;TR DOS
getfil         EQU     #714b;FILE PANEL
ankey          EQU     #714e;WAIT ANY KEY
rpkey          EQU     #7151;WAIT UNTIL ANY KEY UNPRESSED
getarc         EQU     #7154;GET ARC ATR BYTE&ADDRES(BC-COORD)
mscrd          EQU     #7157;GET MOUSE COORDINATES (IN BC)
kilarc         EQU     #715a;KILL 'move window' ARCADE LINE
sssr           EQU     #715d;SAVE SCREEN IN PAGE 7
ussr           EQU     #7160;REPRINT SCREEN FROM PAGE 7
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #6000
               LCODE   "DBG3_33"
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c3c
               ENT
               JP      #7200
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
;----------------------------------------------------
;Now following text of your programm
;----------------------------------------------------
;ДЛЯ ПPИMEPA ИCXOДHИK Setup.o
;----------------------------------------------------
;SETUP 2.0 4 FIRES
;(c)Lynx ... Bug fix ideas by Employer/Alliance
;----------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
setup          PUSH    IX;COXPAHИЛИ OПИCATEЛЬ ПPEД. OKHA
               LD      A,#16;BKЛЮЧИЛИ 6Ю CTPAHИЦУ
               CALL    page;(TAM БУФФEP ГPAФИKИ).
               LD      IX,swin;AДPEC OПИCATEЛЯ OKHA
               CALL    setwin;HAPИCOBAЛИ OKHO.
               CALL    sb_1;OБPAБOTAЛИ
               POP     IX;(!)BOCCTAHOBИЛИ OПИCATEЛЬ ПPEД. OKHA
               LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               RET
;-----------------------
;ПPИ BЫ3OBE OДHOГO OKHA И3 ДPУГOГO HAДO ДEЛATЬ TAK ПEPEД
;BO3BPATOM B ПPEД. OKHO:(ПOCЛE (!))
;CALL REMW
;CALL SETWIN
;TAKИM OБPA3OM BOCCTAHOBИB APKAДHЫE ATTPИБУTЫ ПPEД. OKHA!
;-----------------------
ss             LD      DE,obois
               JP      selset
sm             LD      DE,music
               JP      selset
sa             LD      DE,theme
               JR      selset
spi            LD      DE,plugin
               JR      selset
sc             LD      DE,csr
               JR      selset
sr             LD      DE,resid
               JR      selset
savset         LD      HL,setnm;3AПИCЬ CETAПA
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      C,10
               CALL    dos;K TPДOCУ OБPAЩATCЯ TOЛЬKO ЧEPE3
;ЭTУ TOЧKУ BXOДA
               LD      A,C
               CP      #ff
               JR      NZ,sv_1
               LD      HL,setnm
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      DE,18
               LD      HL,#7000
               LD      C,11
               CALL    dos
               RET
sv_1           LD      C,8
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,(#5cec)
               LD      D,A
               LD      A,(#5ceb)
               LD      E,A
               LD      BC,#106
               LD      HL,#7000
               CALL    dos
               RET
savpro         LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               LD      HL,obois
               LD      DE,#c850
               LD      BC,#5a
               LDIR
               LD      A,(track)
               LD      (#c8aa),A
               LD      HL,#c800
               LD      DE,#0008
               LD      BC,#106
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
               RET
sess           LD      DE,ssaver
;BOT УCTAHOBKA ИMEHИ ФAЙЛA... ПO BЫ3OBУ ФAЙЛOBOГO MEHЮ И KOГДA
;TAM HAЖAЛИ ПPOБEЛ...
selset
               PUSH    DE
               CALL    getfil;ПAHEЛЬ ФAЙЛOBOГO MEHЮ
               CALL    gtadr;У3HAЛИ AДPEC ИMEHИ ФAЙЛA
               POP     DE
               LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      A,#16
               CALL    page
moo            RET
default        LD      HL,obois
               LD      DE,obois+1
               LD      BC,#3e
               LD      (HL),"-"
               LDIR
               RET
;-----------------------------------------
;OБPAБOTЧИK OKHA
;-----------------------------------------
sb_1           CALL    animal;KУPCOP
               CALL    checkw;ПPOBEPKA
               JR      sb_1;3AЦИKЛИЛИ
;-----------------------------------------
;A BOT CAM OПИCATEЛЬ OKHA...
;KAK OПИCЫBATЬ OKHA HAПИCAHO B ФAЙЛE
;KERNEL.W
;-----------------------------------------
swin           DB      3,3,19,11
               DW      s_win,moo,moo
               DB      16,1,1
               DW      st_w
               DB      0,16,2,1
               DW      st_w1
               DB      0,16,3,1
               DW      st_w2
               DB      0,16,4,1
               DW      st_w3
               DB      0,16,5,1
               DW      st_w4
               DB      0,16,6,1
               DW      st_w5
               DB      0,16,7,1
               DW      st_w6
               DB      0,16,8,1
               DW      st_w65
               DB      0,20,2,7
               DW      winatr
               DB      4,20,3,7
               DW      nameatr
               DB      4,20,4,7
               DW      butatr
               DB      4,20,5,7
               DW      koncol
               DB      4,20,6,7
               DW      chbxatr
               DB      4,20,7,7
               DW      border
               DB      2,20,8,7
               DW      dwatr
               DB      4,16,9,1
               DW      st_w7
               DB      0,16,10,1
               DW      st_w8
               DB      0,20,10,7
               DW      track
               DB      4,16,1,11
               DW      st_w9
               DB      0,17,2,11
               DW      cn_w10
               DB      8,17,3,11
               DW      cn_w11
               DB      8,17,4,11
               DW      cn_w12
               DB      8,17,5,11
               DW      cn_w13
               DB      8,17,6,11
               DW      cn_w14
               DB      8,17,7,11
               DW      cn_w15
               DB      8,17,8,11
               DW      cn_w16
               DB      8,17,10,11
               DW      cn_a01
               DB      8,17,11,11
               DW      cn_a02
               DB      8,17,11,1
               DW      df_a03
               DB      9,#FF
s_win          DB      "Setup for Firestarter...",0
st_w           DB      "  -- ATTRIBUTES: --",0
st_w1          DB      " WINDOW:",0
st_w2          DB      " WIN.NAME:",0
st_w3          DB      " BUTTON:",0
st_w4          DB      " KONSOL:",0
st_w5          DB      " CHECK BOX:",0
st_w6          DB      " BORDER:",0
st_w65         DB      " OVR LINE:",0
st_w7          DB      " -- DISK SETUP: --",0
st_w8          DB      " EXTDIR TRK:",0
st_w9          DB      " -- AUTOLOAD PROTOCOL:",0
cn_w10         DW      ss
               DB      "- Select Screen -",0
cn_w11         DW      sm
               DB      "- Select Music -",0
cn_w12         DW      sa
               DB      "- Select App -",0
cn_w13         DW      spi
               DB      "- Select Plug-In -",0
cn_w14         DW      sc
               DB      "- Select Cursor -",0
cn_w15         DW      sr
               DB      "- Select Resident -",0
cn_w16         DW      sess
               DB      "- Select S.Saver -",0
cn_a01         DW      savset
               DB      " -- SAVE SETUP --",0
cn_a02         DW      savpro
               DB      "-- SAVE AUTOLOG --",0
df_a03         DW      default
               DB      "-- Default Autolog --",0
